title: NEB Class 11 Mathematics — Vectors — 2021
subject: mathematics
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: Given $\mathbf{a}=\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+3\hat{k}$ and $\mathbf{b}=3\hat{i}+4\hat{j}-\hat{k}$, find (i) $\mathbf{a}\cdot\mathbf{b}$ and (ii) $|\mathbf{a}\times\mathbf{b}|$, and verify your results.
questions.knowledgeNote: Use $(\mathbf{a}\cdot\mathbf{b})^{2}+|\mathbf{a}\times\mathbf{b}|^{2}=|\mathbf{a}|^{2}|\mathbf{b}|^{2}$ to check both parts at once.
